name: cowart
description: A native fullscreen tldraw canvas for visual thinking and image workflows. Open Cowart from the sidebar or pass projectDir to render_cowart_canvas_widget; reuse the existing canvas for subsequent work.

interface.longDescription: Cowart brings a native tldraw canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. Open Cowart from global navigation and pin it with the host pin control. The sidebar opens a single canvas in the system Documents/Cowart folder, creating the first page when needed. Project conversations with projectDir keep their own project canvas. Image, HTML, Slides and annotation workflows reuse the open canvas.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart canvas for this project.
Use my Cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Cowart AI image holder.
